purpose: Review a finite issuer joint-venture, strategic-alliance, joint-control, capital-contribution, governance-deadlock, operating-obligation and exit lifecycle domain before opening source rows, agreements, filing values, factor values, comparators, security prices or returns.

repository_evidence.supply_chain_boundary: Campaign163 freezes customer, supplier, order and procurement disclosure. A supplier, customer or distributor may be a venture partner, but ordinary trading relationships do not establish a jointly controlled vehicle, reserved matters, contribution duties, governance, deadlock or exit rights.
repository_evidence.board_oversight_boundary: Campaign171 freezes the listed issuer's own board and oversight structure. A joint venture has a separate governance body, partner-appointed seats, voting thresholds, reserved matters, vetoes and deadlock process that cannot be inferred from the listed issuer's board.
repository_evidence.enterprise_ma_boundary: Campaign177 freezes acquisition, disposal, control transfer and integration. Forming or operating a jointly controlled venture without unilateral control is not an acquisition; purchase consideration or control transfer does not prove continuing joint-control, contribution, governance or exit terms.
repository_evidence.credit_facility_boundary: Campaign182 freezes issuer credit facilities, covenants and liquidity backstops. Venture funding commitments, partner guarantees and capital calls require vehicle, partner, agreement and obligation identity and cannot be inferred from consolidated borrowings or liquidity.
repository_evidence.ip_license_boundary: Campaign183 freezes IP licenses and technology transfers. A venture may receive licensed technology, but a license alone does not establish equity ownership, joint control, funding, governance, profit distribution, deadlock or dissolution rights.
repository_evidence.accounting_boundary: Equity-method investment balances, investment income, related-party balances, consolidation status or impairment cannot be renamed as agreement-level joint-control quality without vehicle, partner, agreement, governance, obligation and revision history.
repository_evidence.point_in_time_boundary: A current venture list, current ownership percentage or latest related-party note cannot be projected backward without formation, contribution, transfer, dilution, governance amendment, partner change, breach, deadlock, exit, dissolution, correction and first-public histories.

must_freeze_before_any_formula_or_direct: exact executed joint-venture, shareholders, partnership or strategic-alliance agreement, amendment, exchange filing, registry record or licensed structured source with immutable bytes and stable venture, agreement, party, document and observation identifiers

signing, formation, registration, effective, first-public, contribution due, contribution paid, operation start, milestone, amendment, funding round, partner entry or exit, breach, cure, deadlock, transfer, dissolution, liquidation, correction and supersession timestamps with trading-session availability

issuer, listed security, parent, subsidiary, affiliate, venture vehicle, general or limited partner, partner, beneficial owner, jointly controlling party, related party and ultimate controller mapping without current-state leakage

vehicle taxonomy separating incorporated joint venture, partnership, contractual joint operation, jointly controlled asset, consortium, strategic alliance, associate, ordinary subsidiary, acquisition target and supplier or customer relationship
legal and beneficial ownership, subscribed and paid contribution, dilution, transfer restriction, pre-emption, tag, drag, call, put, buy-sell, joint-control and consolidation-status semantics

board or committee composition, appointment and removal rights, quorum, ordinary and supermajority thresholds, reserved matters, vetoes, casting vote, escalation, mediation, arbitration and deadlock semantics

cash, asset, technology, IP, personnel, customer, supply, guarantee, financing, working-capital, additional-funding and capital-call obligations with unit, currency, due date, condition and fulfillment semantics
business scope, territory, exclusivity, non-compete, procurement, offtake, pricing, service, technology, data, regulatory, performance, audit and information-right obligations
revenue, cost, profit, loss, tax, dividend, distribution, management fee, transfer-pricing, guarantee, debt, contingent liability and off-balance-sheet presentation semantics

default, underfunding, partner breach, waiver, remedy, step-in, suspension, deadlock, dispute, impairment, restructuring, exit, buyout, sale, dissolution, liquidation and residual-asset outcome semantics

consolidated scope, gross and net presentation, currency and unit, accounting versus contractual amount, restatement and missing, undisclosed, not-applicable, pending, waived, disputed, terminated and true-zero semantics

complete bounded 2019-2023 partition manifest, full-market denominator, issuer, vehicle, partner and agreement identifier history, delisting and merger coverage, pagination and parser, identity, timing, ownership, governance, obligation, outcome and source-acceptance tests using no factor, comparator, security-price or return values

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: joint_venture_formation_ownership_contribution_and_joint_control_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known issuer venture-formation state linking vehicle and partners to subscribed and paid contributions, legal and beneficial ownership, voting rights, joint-control conditions, dilution, partner changes and operation commencement.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted point-in-time history freezes venture, agreement and party identity, contribution kind and schedule, paid fulfillment, ownership and voting changes, joint-control tests, registration, operation start, correction and first-public timing across 2019-2023.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: joint_venture_governance_reserved_matters_veto_and_deadlock_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known venture-governance state covering partner-appointed seats, quorum, voting thresholds, reserved matters, vetoes, escalation, mediation, arbitration, buy-sell clauses and unresolved deadlock.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: The repository lacks a complete agreement and amendment history connecting vehicle and partner identity to governance rights, appointed seats, quorum, reserved matters, veto use, dispute, escalation, deadlock resolution, correction and public availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: strategic_alliance_operating_obligation_offtake_technology_and_performance_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known venture or alliance operating state covering business scope, exclusivity, supply or offtake, pricing, technology, personnel, regulatory, service, information and performance obligations and their fulfillment.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No complete point-in-time source links each venture or alliance agreement to operating obligations, responsible partner, due date and condition, delivery and acceptance evidence, amendment, breach, waiver, remedy, correction and trading-session availability.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: joint_venture_additional_funding_distribution_partner_exit_and_dissolution_state
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A close-known venture lifecycle state covering capital calls, partner loans and guarantees, distributions, underfunding, transfer restrictions, options, partner entry or exit, restructuring, dissolution, liquidation and residual assets.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: No admitted source preserves venture funding, guarantee and distribution obligations, partner response, transfer or option exercise, exit consideration, dissolution and liquidation outcomes, revisions, corrections and complete first-public history.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: equity_method_balance_related_party_contract_board_ma_ip_credit_or_security_price_relabeling
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: An existing equity-method balance, related-party transaction, generic contract, listed-company board, acquisition, IP license, credit facility or security-price state relabelled as joint-venture governance or partner alignment.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Accounting classification or an adjacent contract, board, transaction, license, financing or price state does not identify the venture agreement, partners, contribution, joint-control, governance, obligations, deadlock, exit or dissolution chain.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: ownership_contribution_governance_term_direction_denominator_window_or_partner_subset_variant
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A direction, transform or subset of venture count, ownership, contribution completion, funding, distributions, voting rights, vetoes, deadlock, performance, partner type, term or event window.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Choosing more or fewer ventures, high or low ownership or contribution, successful ventures or exits only, partner type, denominator, lag or event window before source admission would multiply hypotheses and introduce survivorship.

finite_prevalue_catalog.name: combined_formation_governance_operating_obligation_funding_exit_score_or_model
finite_prevalue_catalog.economic_state: A joint issuer venture-quality score across formation and contribution, governance and deadlock, operating obligations and funding, distribution and exit outcomes.
finite_prevalue_catalog.reason: Combining four unadmitted heterogeneous source families or choosing normalization, ranks, weights, interactions, filters, subsets or models would expand the search before every base source contract is complete.

scientific_interpretation.safe_conclusion: Four distinct venture formation, governance, operating-obligation and funding or exit lifecycle states remain deferred at source admission; accounting or adjacent-domain relabeling, premature operator search and unadmitted combinations are closed before values.
